note: Status per packet DRY family: concretized (this concept renders a native composition of the role), reused (consumed via shared data/semantics without new composition), not-exercised (belongs to another concept's surfaces). Variance notes are the anti-clone evidence: same product behavior, deliberately different composition.

entries.variance_notes: Destinations exist twice on purpose: compact icon cards in a responsive Home grid, and a persistent workspace-rail list with live counts that stays on every surface. No sibling keeps a permanent per-area rail.
Exactly one critical banner, a compact borderless attention list keyed by status words, and quiet inline notices for honest link-failure explanations.
Workspace-rail shell: named Back, breadcrumb, project chip, persistent compact search, Close Settings. Narrow mode is a one-pane Browse push, never an overlay.
Information-forward grid rows: title + badges, concise description, live control, pm-chip-value state chip, and a Details drawer; state notes render inline with icons, never hover-only.

The concept's first-class citizen: sticky facet column (record kind, area, type, tier, state), chip shortcuts, live count, sort menu, and fixed-height windowed virtualization that stays bounded under stress.
The compendium signature: the calm single-decay row tint plus a contextual About-this-setting panel that opens under the landed row with value/default/changed state and related managers.
Integrated left roster / right detail with per-object tab pages; sections render as titled blocks in one generic grammar (overview, roster, form, table, steps, log, health, preview).

Preview is the showpiece: five count tiles, per-area breakdown table, expandable current-to-incoming diff rows with per-kind stories, credential-by-reference note; apply and rollback ride truthful staged ops.
Hero field on Home, persistent topbar field elsewhere, Ctrl/Cmd+K; dropdown grouped by kind with full paths; selection records the search route first so Back restores query and results.
Shared test-harness chrome by contract; not Settings UI.
All provider state strings come from the shared resolvers; the concept renders them without re-derivation.

entries.variance_notes: Determinate progress only with a real denominator; failed and recovery-required statuses render distinctly.
Command-index navigation and multi-pane keyboard drill-down belong to c10 Conductor; c07 keeps standard focus order, menu arrows, and the dropdown keyboard contract only.
